quality_findings.finding: calcEMA array index i represents a price available at i+period-1; EMA50[i] needs close i+49 and EMA20[i] needs close i+19. Yet both are read for signal at candle i and code enters at same candle close. Historical performance is not PIT-causal. Source report claims opposite-crossover exit, while fixed-holding test-long.mjs never checks opposite-cross exits.
quality_findings.resolution: Block source-code replication. Do not adopt reported win rate as evidence; any causal fix is a new, separately frozen adaptation with author 5 holding and 4 EMA parameter cells.
